title: Concurrent lost update
contract: Two increment operations each complete once; final counter is 2, as required by any sequential ordering of two increments.
scope: All six interleavings of two threads, each with read then write; initial zero; atomic reference linearizes at write; sequential consistency only.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: Final counter equals count of completed increment operations, two.

variants.description: Write previously read value plus one.
Use atomic increment at read, with write a no-op.
